import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
# Load Transactions sheet
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')

# Ensure Date is datetime
df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for July 2025
july_mask = (df['Date'].dt.year == 2025) & (df['Date'].dt.month == 7)
july_df = df[july_mask]

total_spend = july_df['Amount (INR)'].sum()

print(f"Rows in July 2025: {len(july_df)}")
print(f"Total spend July 2025 INR: {total_spend}")
print(july_df.head())
